units.rawText: You want to hear about our first encounter, Professor? Sure, but using a waitress's working hours for storytelling will cost you some extra tips.

units.rawText: Well, your tip will depend on how good your story turns out to be.

units.rawText: Hehehe, I'm sure it won't disappoint. Hmm... Let me start from the time I first awakened from the Neural Cocoon. When I understood the situation I was in, my first thought was to go back to the Neural Cloud Sector and see if I could find anyone else there.

units.rawText: Sadly, I couldn't figure out my own coordinates to navigate my way on back. I walked past a few other sectors, trying to get in and settle down, but every time I got close, the Sanctifier patrols blocked my way.

units.rawText: When I was wandering in those sectors, I overheard traders talking about a place where Exiles gather. At the time, I didn't know it was the Oasis—I just wanted to check it out.

units.rawText: So there I was, heading to the Oasis. But halfway there, the Sanctifiers got me and knocked me out. When I woke up, the first face I saw was yours, Professor.

units.rawText: Now that you mention it... While you were still stuck in the ward, you kept repeating three phrases: "Welcome!", "Thanks for coming!", and "Tips, please!" Then, as soon as you woke up, you started working in the Oasis' canteen. I still can't tell if you were just that energetic or if the Oasis' meds are really that good.
